name: Jewel Boom Super Drop
review:
Jewel Boom Super Drop is a simple 3x1, pay-on-line game styled like a one-armed bandit, published by BGaming using its EZreel system. Gems and golden chests spin on a shiny golden grid.

The Collector Bonus is the main feature: collect diamonds to unlock jackpots, with five jackpots on offer. BGaming rates it medium-low volatility with a 3,000x maximum and a 96.5% RTP. It's very easy to understand and plays quickly, making it a good fit for short, casual demo sessions. Its success led to the follow-up Bling Blitz Diamond Drop.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
